author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Unraveling Loom
summary: Chasmweaver and phase spiders have nested in the Wording Loom, among the threads that weave each page's text.

parts.text: A loom as wide as a house clacks in the dark, its shuttles flying on their own. Threads of every shade run from it up through the ceiling. Some of them are not thread: two vast spiders hang among them, and smaller ones flicker in and out of sight along the warp.

The {ref:creature/chasmweaver-spider}s strung their lines among the loom's threads, and the {ref:creature/phase-spider}s blink in and out to bite. Once they are dealt with, the party can follow the threads: each one carries a mark of punctuation to the pages upstairs. One anomaly's source is here; see the Anomaly Ledger.
